boundary: the splitting is verified EXHAUSTIVELY at n = 1: the Clifford group is a complete closure modulo global phase, its order and the Pauli subgroup's order are checked against 216 and 9, and the complement is exhibited with its intersection computed. It is NOT verified at n = 2 -- the two-qutrit Clifford group modulo phase has order 4,199,040 and was not built -- so for the compiler's actual dimension this rests on the cited general odd-p result. The eighty canonical lifts are NOT produced here. Unitaries are compared numerically at 1e-6, not in exact cyclotomic arithmetic. tau_2 is untouched
